title: ArtistRegistry
description: Canonical schema for the repo-root artists.json global artist registry, matching AGENTS.md exactly.

id.description: Permanent kebab-case slug, derived from name (diacritics stripped, lowercased). Never changes once assigned. Referenced by festival.json's Artist.globalId (or directly as Artist.id for a new single-show artist).

name.description: Display name, may include diacritics, e.g. 'Drekka Sjór'.

description.description: Free-text bio, same style as festival.json's Artist.description.

genres.description: Free-text genre labels, same convention as festival.json's Artist.genres.

country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code, lowercase, e.g. 'us', 'de'. Omitted rather than guessed when unresolved.
